capabilities: : Rename active notes using external scripts
: Hook into Obsidian's new note creation process
extras: External generator functionality is limited to desktop applications; mobile devices default to random GUID generation.
intentEvidence: This plugin separates when a name is needed (new note, rename) from how it is produced, and lets you delegate the "how" to a script of your choice.
motivation: To separate the timing of when a name is needed from how that name is produced, allowing delegation to a custom script.
problem: Existing note naming solutions are hard-coded to a single scheme (like timestamps or GUID), lacking flexibility for custom generation logic.
summary: A note naming utility that generates or renames notes using a random GUID or the output of a configurable external script.
